name: CL Futures: EIA Petroleum Inventory Reaction
description: Measures how WTI crude oil (CL) moves around the weekly EIA Petroleum Status Report (Wednesdays 10:30am ET). Anchors to the open of the 10:30am release bar and computes average absolute price moves at +1, +5, +15, and 30 minutes post-release. Outputs: summary table of avg absolute moves (% and $/bbl), bar chart comparing the 4 windows, and event markers for each EIA release with per-window moves. 5-year lookback, ~260 events. 1-min bars, NoAdjustment for intraday dollar accuracy.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CL FUTURES: EIA PETROLEUM INVENTORY REACTION
# =============================================================================
# Question: How large is the average absolute price move in CL at 1, 5, 15,
#   and 30 minutes after the weekly EIA Petroleum Status Report (10:30am ET)?
#
# Method:
#   - EIA release detected via economic_calendar(release_id=75)
#   - Anchor price = open of the 10:30am ET bar (release bar)
#   - Absolute move at +N min = |close_at_N - anchor_open|
#   - Reported in both % and $/bbl
#   - 5-year lookback, ~260 events
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table: avg absolute move (% and $/bbl) per window
#   2. Bar chart: avg absolute move ($/bbl) across 4 windows
#   3. Event markers: each EIA release with per-window moves
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
open_price = cont.o

# --- EIA Calendar Detection ---
# FRED release_id=75 = EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report (Wednesdays 10:30am ET)
eia_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=75)()
# Carry the release flag through the entire trading day (intraday bars)
is_eia_day = ffill_day(eia_cal.is_released)

# --- Identify the 10:30am ET Release Bar ---
# time_of_day returns minutes since midnight in the given timezone
# 10:30am ET = 10*60 + 30 = 630 minutes since midnight
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(index())
is_1030_bar = bar_tod == 630

# The release bar: EIA day AND exactly 10:30am ET
is_release_bar = is_eia_day and is_1030_bar

# --- Anchor Price: Open of the 10:30am Release Bar ---
# barssince counts bars since the release bar (0 on release bar, 1 one bar later, etc.)
bars_since_release = coalesce(barssince()(is_release_bar), 9999)

# Capture the anchor open using valuewhen (open at the release bar)
anchor_open = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_release_bar, open_price)

# --- Forward Closes at +1, +5, +15, +30 Minutes ---
# We measure the close N bars after the release bar.
# On the bar that is exactly N bars after release, bars_since_release == N.
# We use where() to isolate that bar's close, then valuewhen to carry it back
# to the release bar for event marker display.

# Close at +1 min (bars_since_release == 1)
is_1min_bar  = bars_since_release == 1
is_5min_bar  = bars_since_release == 5
is_15min_bar = bars_since_release == 15
is_30min_bar = bars_since_release == 30

close_at_1  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_1min_bar,  close)
close_at_5  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_5min_bar,  close)
close_at_15 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_15min_bar, close)
close_at_30 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_30min_bar, close)

# --- Absolute Moves ($/bbl and %) ---
# Dollar move: |close_at_N - anchor_open|
# Percent move: |close_at_N - anchor_open| / anchor_open
# Both are computed on the +N bar and then carried back to the release bar via valuewhen.

# $/bbl absolute moves — computed on the +N bar
abs_dollar_1_raw  = where(is_1min_bar,  abs(close - anchor_open))
abs_dollar_5_raw  = where(is_5min_bar,  abs(close - anchor_open))
abs_dollar_15_raw = where(is_15min_bar, abs(close - anchor_open))
abs_dollar_30_raw = where(is_30min_bar, abs(close - anchor_open))

# % absolute moves — computed on the +N bar
abs_pct_1_raw  = where(is_valid(anchor_open) and is_1min_bar,  abs(close - anchor_open) / anchor_open)
abs_pct_5_raw  = where(is_valid(anchor_open) and is_5min_bar,  abs(close - anchor_open) / anchor_open)
abs_pct_15_raw = where(is_valid(anchor_open) and is_15min_bar, abs(close - anchor_open) / anchor_open)
abs_pct_30_raw = where(is_valid(anchor_open) and is_30min_bar, abs(close - anchor_open) / anchor_open)

# Carry each move back to the release bar for event markers
abs_dollar_1  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_1min_bar,  abs_dollar_1_raw)
abs_dollar_5  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_5min_bar,  abs_dollar_5_raw)
abs_dollar_15 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_15min_bar, abs_dollar_15_raw)
abs_dollar_30 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_30min_bar, abs_dollar_30_raw)

abs_pct_1  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_1min_bar,  abs_pct_1_raw)
abs_pct_5  = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_5min_bar,  abs_pct_5_raw)
abs_pct_15 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_15min_bar, abs_pct_15_raw)
abs_pct_30 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_30min_bar, abs_pct_30_raw)

# --- Filter to Release Bars Only (for aggregation) ---
# All reporter aggregations run on these sparse series (one value per EIA release)
d1_on_release  = where(is_release_bar, abs_dollar_1)
d5_on_release  = where(is_release_bar, abs_dollar_5)
d15_on_release = where(is_release_bar, abs_dollar_15)
d30_on_release = where(is_release_bar, abs_dollar_30)

p1_on_release  = where(is_release_bar, abs_pct_1)
p5_on_release  = where(is_release_bar, abs_pct_5)
p15_on_release = where(is_release_bar, abs_pct_15)
p30_on_release = where(is_release_bar, abs_pct_30)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Avg Absolute Move per Window (table first)
# =============================================================================
# Rows: +1min, +5min, +15min, +30min
# Cols: Avg Abs Move ($/bbl), Avg Abs Move (%)
# Uses standard mode with explicit grid_row/grid_col positioning
# PercentFormat multiplies by 100 — pass raw decimal (e.g. 0.005 → 0.5%)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release: Avg Absolute CL Move',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['+1 Min', '+5 Min', '+15 Min', '+30 Min'],
        col_headers=['Avg Abs Move ($/bbl)', 'Avg Abs Move (%)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=1
)(d1_on_release, p1_on_release, d5_on_release, p5_on_release, d15_on_release, p15_on_release, d30_on_release, p30_on_release)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Bar Chart — Avg Absolute Move ($/bbl) Across 4 Windows
# =============================================================================
# Series mode: each column = one bar, named via BarSeriesSchema
# Shows how the move builds (or decays) over the 30-min post-release window
xy_bars(
    title='How Far Does CL Move After the EIA Report?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move ($/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Min',  color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min',  color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 Min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 Min', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(d1_on_release, d5_on_release, d15_on_release, d30_on_release))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Event Markers — Each EIA Release with Per-Window Moves
# =============================================================================
# Fires on the release bar (10:30am ET on EIA Wednesdays)
# Hero: +5min move (most actionable window)
# Subtitle: anchor open price
# Details: all 4 windows
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Petroleum Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Anchor Open ($/bbl)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+1 Min Move ($/bbl)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='+5 Min Move ($/bbl)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='+15 Min Move ($/bbl)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='+30 Min Move ($/bbl)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='+1 Min Move (%)', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(anchor_open, abs_dollar_1, abs_dollar_5, abs_dollar_15, abs_dollar_30, abs_pct_1, is_release_bar)
